description: Durable disposition ledger for the 89 CI-RED PR cohort on organvm/limen as of 2026-08-10. Each PR is classified into one of three buckets per DRAIN-0810-DISPOSITION-CIRED: auto-fixable → routed to self-heal; human-gated → lever in his-hand-levers.json; rest → lifecycle disposition.
disposition_rule: for each PR: if auto-fixable (CAPFILL/HEAL-cifix/ORG- pattern + no human decision needed) → self-heal route; if human-gated (lever exists in his-hand-levers.json) → lever; else → lifecycle:blocked (default) or lifecycle:preservation (custody) or lifecycle:superseded (named successor).

auto_fixable_self_heal.rationale: These are heal-loop auto-fix branches or known-pattern CI-RED that self-heal.py can address on next cycle. CAPFILL era June 29, ORG- healing, recovery lanes, HEAL-cifix explicit — all have mechanistic fixes.

human_gated_lever.rationale: In-flight DRAIN-0810 workstreams (T1, T5) — human decides merge timing via umbrella #2297.

lifecycle_blocked.rationale: Stale-base legacy lanes (created Jun-Jul, updated 2026-07-24); mergeable unknown/dirty; no active owner; fail-closed pending lifecycle review.

lifecycle_preservation.rationale: No CI-RED PRs with custody:preservation label detected in this cohort.

lifecycle_superseded.rationale: No explicitly superseded PRs detected in this cohort.
